entities.title: Build and test the C# library
entities.summary: Install the .NET 8 SDK and run dotnet test in implementations/csharp.
steps: Install a .NET SDK that builds net8.0 with C# 12 (the projects set TargetFramework net8.0 and LangVersion 12; there is no global.json).
dotnet test (restores the xUnit packages, builds Utv.sln with warnings as errors, and runs Utv.Tests and Utv.Examples.Tests)
dotnet test tests/Utv.Examples.Tests runs only the examples
For the native-first zone examples, the host's tz database must know New York's and Paris's 2026–2027 rules
entities.verify: dotnet test reports no failed tests.
entities.details: The tests read schema/ and conformance/ from the repository root, so run them in a full checkout. After changing a UTV-first test inside task markers, regenerate docs/side-by-side.md (tests/Utv.Examples.Tests/UtvFirst/.dev/runbooks.json).
